/seo/metaDescription.source_en: Winter-season coach day tour from Seoul: snow-covered ⟦G0⟧, Nami Island's frosted tree avenues, and the Eobi Valley ice wall in Gapyeong. Hongik University or ⟦G1⟧ pickup, park entry and Nami ferry included.
